llm_response: This experiment showed a drastic regression across all primary metrics compared to the previous best, with ROC AUC Macro falling from ~0.99 to ~0.91, and F1 Macro dropping from ~0.52 to ~0.14. The combination of the CNN-Attention architecture and the current augmentation settings appears significantly weaker than the baseline EfficientNet-B0. The major drop suggests the CNN-Attention block is not capturing necessary contextual information, or the current hyperparameters are suboptimal. The next experiment should re-evaluate the attention mechanism by incorporating temporal modeling (e.g., adding a Transformer encoder layer) and reintroducing time_shift augmentation, while keeping the learning rate at 0.001.
